calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist_orders, min(o.order_ts_utc), max(o.order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.status, o.web_order_id, o.order_ts_utc, o.line_count, count(f.sales_line_id) AS lines,
  max(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test, max(s.store_id) AS store
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 21:00:00' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 23:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING max(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 OR count(f.sales_line_id)=0 AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled','processing') OR max(s.store_id)=999

SELECT count(*) AS rows_all, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_content
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT count(*) AS web_orders_placed_cyber_monday_2025
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
